about: V&A Explore the Collections: a JSON CLI over the Victoria and Albert Museum's public collections API. It can search and filter museum objects, fetch object records, IIIF manifests and image info, get facet counts, autocomplete makers, search archives, export results as CSV and browse organisation pages.

commands.summary: Search V&A collection objects by keyword. Filters: maker, object name, material, place, accession number, category, place/material/technique/person/organisation/collection IDs, has-image and on-displa

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text keyword searched across all fields

params.name: q_actor
params.description: Search only the Artist/maker field (person or organisation name)

params.name: q_object_name
params.description: Search only the title / object type field

params.name: q_material_technique
params.description: Search only the materials and techniques field

params.name: q_place_name
params.description: Search only the place name field

params.name: q_accession_number
params.description: Search by museum accession number, e.g. M.934-1983

params.name: images_exist
params.description: true = only objects that have images

params.name: kw_location_type
params.description: Location type filter. 'display' = only objects currently on display

params.name: id_place
params.description: Place-of-origin facet ID, e.g. x29523 (Yorkshire), x28980 (London)

params.name: kw_object_type
params.description: Exact object type keyword, e.g. Teapot

commands.summary: Export object search results as CSV text. Takes the same main filters as search-objects.
Get the full catalogue record for one museum object by its system number (the digits after 'O', e.g. O151155 -> 151155).

params.name: object_num
params.description: Numeric part of the object system number (O151155 -> 151155)

commands.summary: Get the IIIF presentation manifest (all images with their image service URLs) for an object.

params.name: object_num
params.description: Numeric part of the object system number (O94917 -> 94917)

commands.summary: Get IIIF image info (dimensions, tile sizes, supported formats) for an image asset ID such as _primaryImageId.

params.name: asset_ref
params.description: Image asset reference, e.g. 2007BP1152 (the _primaryImageId field from search results)

commands.summary: Get facet counts (categories, people, places, materials, techniques, etc.) for an object search.

params.name: cluster_size
params.description: Number of terms returned per facet

commands.summary: List the values and counts of one facet type (e.g. place, material, category) for an object search. Use this to find facet IDs for search-objects.

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text keyword to scope the counts

commands.summary: Search-as-you-type suggestions for people and organisations (makers), returning their IDs for use in id_person / id_organisation filters.
Search the V&A archives index (archive collections and records) by keyword.
List the site's built-in suggested facets (popular places, etc.) with their system-number IDs.
List organisations in the collection A–Z for a given starting letter, with their organisation IDs and profile URLs.
Open an organisation profile page and list its featured collection objects.

params.name: org_id
params.description: Organisation ID, e.g. A22676 or AUTH407110 (taken from list-organisations URLs)

params.name: slug
params.description: URL slug of the organisation name, e.g. apple-inc.
